name: CoreUI Brands
about: CoreUI Brands is a free, open-source icon set with 831 icons designed by creativeLabs Łukasz Holeczek. Ideal for login buttons, partner walls, tech-stack badges and social links - every logo is a clean vector. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC0 1.0.

faqs.q: Are CoreUI Brands free to use?
faqs.a: The icon files themselves are open source under the CC0 1.0 license – free to download and use. But company logos are trademarks of their owners, so always check each brand's usage guidelines before commercial use.

faqs.q: Can I use CoreUI Brands logos in commercial projects?
faqs.a: You can freely download and embed the vector files under the CC0 1.0 license, but trademark law still applies: don't imply endorsement by a brand, and follow each company's brand guidelines for clear-space, colors and minimum sizes.

faqs.q: How do I use CoreUI Brands in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many CoreUI Brands are there?
faqs.a: There are 831 icons in the CoreUI Brands set, designed by creativeLabs Łukasz Holeczek. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: What formats are CoreUI Brands available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
